description.title: Description
description.description: Text description of the tiles. For best control, number each tile variation: '1). grass tile 2). stone tile 3). lava tile'.

tile_type.title: Tile Type
tile_type.description: Shape of the tiles. hex: flat-top hexagonal, hex_pointy: pointy-top hexagonal, isometric: diamond/rhombus, oblique: true square top with the depth extruded diagonally down-right at 45 degrees (tileset/building only), octagon: 8-sided polygon, square_topdown: square at angle.

tile_size.title: Tile Size
tile_size.description: Tile size in pixels (16-128). 32px is recommended for most use cases. Connectable sets (tile_feature) have tighter per-shape ranges; square top-down roads are exactly 32.

tile_height.title: Tile Height
tile_height.description: Tile height in pixels for non-square tiles (e.g., 128 for 64x128 tiles). When omitted, height is computed from tile_type geometry and view angle.

tile_view.title: Tile View
tile_view.description: View angle controlling tile depth. top-down: no depth, high top-down: ~15%, low top-down: ~30%, side: ~50%.

tile_view_angle.title: Tile View Angle
tile_view_angle.description: Continuous view angle in degrees (0-90). Overrides tile_view when provided. 0=side, 90=top-down.

tile_depth_ratio.title: Tile Depth Ratio
tile_depth_ratio.description: Tile depth/thickness ratio (0.0-1.0). Controls how much vertical depth the tile has. Overrides the default computed from tile_view.

tile_flat_top_px.title: Tile Flat Top Px
tile_flat_top_px.description: Isometric top/bottom cap width: 2px classic or 4px modern. Only used when tile_type='isometric'.

outline_mode.title: Outline Mode
outline_mode.description: Tile guide style. outline: gray shading with outlines. segmentation: color zones without outlines, giving cleaner seamless edges.

tile_feature.title: Tile Feature
tile_feature.description: Generate a connectable set instead of independent tiles. roads: 18-config path autotiles (square_topdown, isometric). tileset: terrain transition — a 16-tile corner set for square_topdown/isometric/oblique, or a 32-tile coastline for hex/hex_pointy; describe it as a transition ("grass to water"), first terrain is the main one. building: construction kit — floor, connectable walls, doorways, pillar and staircase (square_topdown, isometric, oblique). Connectable sets return per-tile placement rules; see GET /tiles-pro/{tile_id}. Cannot be combined with style_images. Note: for square top-down terrain transitions, /create-tileset is the dedicated tileset model and offers transition width, per-terrain reference images and style matching.

building_wall_tiles.title: Building Wall Tiles
building_wall_tiles.description: Building kits: wall height in tiles (1-3). Defaults to 2.

building_layout.title: Building Layout
building_layout.description: Building kits: grid paints each shaped piece individually (richer, isometric default); materials paints flat swatches and renders pieces from them (more consistent, default for square_topdown/oblique).

building_wall_description.title: Building Wall Description
building_wall_description.description: Building kits: wall material, e.g. 'stone brick walls'. More reliable than relying on the description being split.

building_floor_description.title: Building Floor Description
building_floor_description.description: Building kits: floor material, e.g. 'wooden plank floor'.

building_floor2_description.title: Building Floor2 Description
building_floor2_description.description: Building kits: upper-storey/roof surface. Defaults to the wall material.

building_wall_angle.title: Building Wall Angle
building_wall_angle.description: Building kits, square_topdown only: wall storey height as its own camera angle, decoupled from the ground pitch.

oblique_lean.title: Oblique Lean
oblique_lean.description: Oblique tilesets and building walls: horizontal shear per pixel of height. 0.5 is classic cabinet (~27 degrees), 1.0 is a full 45 degree diagonal (default for oblique).

style_images.title: Style Images
style_images.description: Style reference tiles. When provided, generated tiles will match these tiles' style and dimensions. The tile_type, tile_size, tile_view, tile_view_angle, and tile_depth_ratio are ignored — the style tiles define the shape.

style_options.description: Options for what to copy from the style images. Only used when style_images is provided.

#/components/schemas/CreateCharacterV3Re.description:
Request model for /v2/create-character-v3.

Two modes:
- **Reference image**: provide `reference_image` (south-facing) — v3 rotates it
  into 8 directions. Add `direction_images` for directions you already drew;
  v3 then generates only the rest. Works for quadruped `template_id`s too.
- **From scratch**: omit `reference_image` — pixen generates a sprite from
  `description`, then v3 rotates it. Supports extra style params (`outline`, `detail`).

mode.title: Mode
mode.description:
Which animation mode to use. Prefer `'v3'` (default) — it usually produces higher quality results than `'pro'`, and is cheaper. Use `'pro'` only when its different stylistic output is specifically needed.

**Cost warning**: when generating on a subscription, `'pro'` mode costs 10-25 generations per direction (80-200 for a full 8-direction animation).

animation_description.title: Animation Description
animation_description.description: Describe the animation, e.g. 'walking cheerfully'. Required when creating a new animation; can be omitted when adding directions to an existing animation via animation_group_id (the existing description is inherited).

directions.title: Directions
directions.description:
Which directions to animate.

- **Do not pass `directions` for 1-direction objects.** They always animate the single internal direction; passing this returns 400.
- For 8-direction objects:
  - **New animation**: omit `directions` to animate all 8 cardinals.
  - **Extending an existing animation** (via `animation_group_id`): omit `directions` to fill in only the cardinals not yet generated. You usually don't need to compute the missing set yourself — pass `animation_group_id` alone and the server figures it out.
  - If you do pass it explicitly, values must be a subset of the 8 cardinals.

animation_group_id.title: Animation Group Id
animation_group_id.description: Mostly only relevant for 8-direction objects: pass the animation_group_id of an existing animation on this object to add more directions to it. Omit to create a new animation; the new animation_group_id is returned so subsequent calls can extend it.

display_name.title: Display Name
display_name.description: Optional name for the animation, shown in the UI and used when exporting.

frame_count.title: Frame Count
frame_count.description:
Frames per direction. Each direction in an animation is independent — you do not need to match `frame_count` across directions when extending an existing animation. Just omit it and the per-mode default is used.

- `mode='v3'`: any even number 4-16 (default 8). Heads-up: v3 stores the input reference frame alongside the generated ones (unless `keep_first_frame=false`), so `frame_count=8` results in **9** frames stored (and reported by `get_object`). When extending a v3 animation whose stored `frame_count` is 9, just omit this field — the default still produces a matching 9-frame output.
- `mode='pro'`: depends on object canvas (longest side):
  - canvas ≤ 64px → 16 frames (only)
  - canvas ≤ 128px → 4, 9, or 16 frames
  - canvas ≤ 170px → 9 frames (only)
  - canvas larger than 170px → pro not supported (use `mode='v3'`)
  - default: smallest available count for the canvas size

replace_existing.title: Replace Existing
replace_existing.description: Set true to regenerate a direction that has already been animated in this animation. Without this, attempting to re-animate the same direction returns 409.

custom_start_frame.description:
Optional custom starting pose for the animation (`mode='v3'` only). When omitted, the object's idle frame for the chosen direction is used as the start. When provided, the image's dimensions become the canvas for the animation (subject to v3's 256x256 maximum).

**Requires exactly one direction.**
- 8-direction objects: the caller must specify which direction the animation is for. The eight options are south, south-west, west, north-west, north, north-east, east, south-east. Pass that one direction as `directions=[<that direction>]`. For AI agents calling this endpoint: ASK the user which direction they want; do not pick one yourself or default to south.
- 1-direction objects: do not pass `directions` at all; the single internal direction is auto-resolved.

Not compatible with `mode='pro'`.

end_frame.description:
Optional target pose to interpolate toward (`mode='v3'` only). Providing this enables **interpolation mode**: the model animates between the start frame (idle or `custom_start_frame`) and this end frame. Dimensions must match the start frame.

**Requires exactly one direction.**
- 8-direction objects: the caller must specify which direction the animation is for. The eight options are south, south-west, west, north-west, north, north-east, east, south-east. Pass that one direction as `directions=[<that direction>]`. For AI agents calling this endpoint: ASK the user which direction they want; do not pick one yourself or default to south.
- 1-direction objects: do not pass `directions` at all; the single internal direction is auto-resolved.

Not compatible with `mode='pro'`.

keep_first_frame.title: Keep First Frame
keep_first_frame.description: Keep the input reference frame as frame 0 of the stored animation (`mode='v3'` only). Set `false` to store exactly `frame_count` generated frames — the reference start frame is stripped, so `frame_count=8` stores 8 frames instead of 9. Not compatible with `mode='pro'`.

enhance_prompt.title: Enhance Prompt

Grounded on `custom_start_frame`/`end_frame` when provided, otherwise on the object's idle frame. The same enhanced description is reused across all requested directions. async_mode.description: Process in background (always true - no foreground processing yet)

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Animation mode. "template": skeleton-based from template_animation_id (1 gen/direction). "skeleton-v3": the same template_animation_id posed onto the character, which moves the character instead of redrawing it each frame — steadier identity and colours, 2-4 generations and ~3-5 min per direction, beta. end_frame.description: Optional target pose to interpolate toward (`mode='v3'` or `mode='pixminimax'`). Requires exactly one direction. Not compatible with `mode='template'` or `mode='pro'`.

subject_description.title: Subject Description

initial_pose.title: Initial Pose

text_guidance_scale.title: Text Guidance Scale

shading.title: Shading
